subtasks.title: Implement and export slugify
subtasks.goal:
Add the string utility and expose it through the existing entry point.
Absent src/slug.mjs → create a named export function slugify(text), returning text.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, ''). Follow the existing semicolon-free ES module style.
src/index.mjs version-only export → retain export const version = 1 and append export { slugify } from './slug.mjs'.
Do not modify tests or other existing files; no code is removed.
